items.title: Airbnb says it’s launching an AI travel agent in the first half of 2027
items.summary: Airbnb announces plans to launch an AI-powered travel agent in early 2027, aiming to revolutionize trip planning and booking experiences.

items.title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast and cost-effective with longer clips
items.summary: Google introduces Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, a new model variant designed for faster and more cost-effective processing of longer video clips.

items.title: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
items.summary: OpenAI announces GPT-6 Cyber, a new initiative focused on developing advanced and aligned AI agents for enhanced cybersecurity applications.

items.title: Turns Matter: Advancing Streaming Video RL via Turn-Level Credit
items.summary: This research introduces a novel approach to reinforcement learning for streaming video, improving agent performance by assigning credit at the turn-level.

items.title: From Pixels to Actions - Towards Native Vision-Language-Action Policies
items.summary: New research explores the development of vision-language-action policies, enabling AI agents to interpret visual information and perform actions more naturally.

items.title: Meta says US users can now video chat with their Muse AI avatar
items.summary: Meta expands its Muse AI avatar capabilities, allowing US users to engage in video chats with their personalized AI companions.

items.title: Meta warns that election backlash against data centers could make AI expansion harder
items.summary: Meta expresses concern that public backlash against data centers, potentially fueled by election-related issues, could impede future AI infrastructure expansion.

items.title: Congrats to the Kaggle Benchmarking Challenge Winners!
items.summary: Kaggle announces the winners of its latest benchmarking challenge, highlighting advancements in competitive AI model performance.

items.title: WebMCP Attack Lab: Can an E-Shop Hijack Your AI Agent?
items.summary: This article explores potential vulnerabilities where malicious e-shops could hijack AI agents, raising concerns about agent security and trust.

items.title: FrontierPhysics: Evaluating Agents for End-to-End Physics Research
items.summary: A new paper introduces FrontierPhysics, a framework designed to evaluate AI agents capable of conducting end-to-end research in physics.

items.title: What Does Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning Really Improve in LLM Agents?
items.summary: This paper investigates the specific benefits and improvements that multi-turn reinforcement learning brings to the capabilities of Large Language Model agents.

items.title: One Markdown File Can Hijack Your AI Coding Agent: The Hidden Cost of Blindly Trusting AGENTS.md
items.summary: This piece warns about the security risks of blindly trusting `AGENTS.md` files, demonstrating how a single markdown file can compromise an AI coding agent.

items.title: VFlash: Fast, Accurate Visual Planning via Flash Primitive Decoding
items.summary: New research introduces VFlash, a method for fast and accurate visual planning that utilizes flash primitive decoding to enhance AI agent efficiency.

items.title: An AI Testing Presentation Became the Final Push for Organizational Change at My Company
items.summary: A developer shares how an AI testing presentation catalyzed significant organizational change within their company, emphasizing the growing importance of AI in development workflows.

items.title: Don't Write Markdown Files for Your Coding Agent. Write Scripts.
items.summary: An article advises developers to use scripts instead of markdown files for instructing AI coding agents, suggesting a more robust and reliable approach.
